_comment: Single source of truth for prices. Adopted from Ladder B (prosumer, perpetual-first) in docs/research/market/pricing-landscape-and-strategy.md; clients read display strings from the stores at runtime, the website reads this file at build time.
principles: Perpetual option on every consumer plan
Perpetual = 12 months of feature updates, security updates forever, never expires
Subscriptions can be cancelled in one click

standard.name: MIRRORZ Standard
standard.tagline: Run Windows and PC apps on your Mac. AutoCAD-ready.
standard.update_pass_note: Optional yearly update pass after the included 12 months; never required to keep working.

pro.name: MIRRORZ Pro
pro.tagline: Everything in Standard for 5 Macs, plus developer & power tools.

business.name: MIRRORZ Business
business.tagline: Per-seat, centrally managed, MDM-deployable, priority support with SLA.

switch.name: Switch from Parallels, VMware or CrossOver
switch.proof: any Parallels/VMware/CrossOver licence key or receipt; verified by support
extras: one-click import of Windows apps found in an existing Parallels VM

ios_app_store.note: Companion app; purchases sync to the Mac via the same Apple ID / MIRRORZ account

google_play.note: Companion app; one-time products for perpetual

direct.note: Perpetual keys delivered by email; notarized direct-download build. Perpetual buyers are steered direct because the App Store cannot sell paid version upgrades cleanly.

rationale: CrossOver+ ($74/yr) is the direct comparable for a translation layer; Parallels Standard is $99.99/yr or $219.99 perpetual plus a separate Windows licence; MIRRORZ Bottles need no Windows licence, so first-year total cost is under one third of Parallels + Windows. Perpetual answers the strongest review sentiment (forced renewals, perpetual price hikes).
